This is a model-template for copy-and-pasting the core elements required for UART comms in every model that runs in the KISPE-created runtime test environment.

This model-template model provides an example of how a model hooks into the tf_common library to send log output, register tests, and submit test results. The underlying test-reporter lib will only transmit coverage data over the UART once all registered tests have submitted a test result.

1. The above two TASTE Functions should be copied and pasted into the new model. Their interface nodes should then be connected with a line.

2. The new model's samrh71 Deployment View should be created as follows:
- Two instances of SAM RH71 RTEMS N7S, ideally positioned side by side for consistency (Partition_2 on the right).
- The "uart1" node on both instances connected together
- Partition_2 should be bound to the TASTE Function "UartOtherEnd" only
- Partition_1 should be bound to all other TASTE Functions in the model
- In the Partition_1 Properties dialog in the Attributes tab set Extra libs to: "../../../../tf_common/"
- In the Properties dialog for the uart-connecting line, in Message Bindings tick the "TF_Reporter.samrh71tx<->UartOtherEnd.samrh71.tx" entry
- In the Properties dailog for each samrh71's uart1 node set the Config to: "devname uart1, speed b115200, parity even, transmit-mode raw-single-byte"
- In the Properties dailog for each samrh71's uart1 node set the Packetizer to "passthrough"

3. Copy the following lines from this templates Makefile into that of the new model:
- PARTITION_1_USER_CFLAGS
- PARTITION_1_USER_LDFLAGS
- PARTITION_1_USER_LDSCRIPT_DIR
- PARTITION_1_USER_LDSCRIPT

NOTE: If the new model needs its own custom linker script you can create one locally in the model but MUST include the ".gcov_info" section in the model's custom liner script.
